scope.status: ENGINEERING DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR ORDER
scope.silkscreen: White, both sides; J4 numbered signal labels and ESP32 wiring key
scope.mechanical_change: J1-J3 rotated 180 degrees with wire entry toward lower edge (+Y); input labels 1-12 and electrical paths unchanged. Uses Rev D firmware.
scope.input_scope: One common floating DC supply; any positive/return/open assignment, with at least one positive and one return for live classification. Measure only; no power outputs or continuity test.
scope.power: One USB cable to Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-1.28; five-wire harness. USB5V preregulated to 3.3V before isolation.
scope.display: Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-1.28 non-touch; external MCU/display module
scope.isolation: Functional isolation from USB; not mains or CAT rated.
scope.accuracy: Target +/-0.15V near 12V after room-temperature calibration; not physically verified.
scope.48V_note: Calculation stress only, not a survival rating.

1=VSYS/5V,2=GND,3=3V3,4=GPIO6 SDA,5=GPIO7 SCL. One USB cable to Waveshare powers both boards.
Primary 3.3V preregulator avoids 4.5V minimum requirement at USB-fed isolated converter. 500mA rating.
30V VIN withstands unregulated converter output. EN intentionally floating, internally enabled; do not tie to VIN. Integrated reverse-current blocking.
Functional isolation, 100kHz I2C. Non-isolated host pullups on Waveshare.
C7465186 exact manufacturer. 3.3V input, 5V unregulated output; 20mA minimum output load supplied by five 1k resistors. Through-hole, JLC Economic eligible.
